text_block_list.text:
In the evening on the day of the race, as 
I was handling some work in the Trainer's 
Room, Symboli Rudolf came by...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe that a Trainer and an Umamusume 
should treat each other with mutual 
respect.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"We will continue to walk side by side, so 
the least I can do is match your stride."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Therefore, let me put it bluntly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I think I've been racing too much lately.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue from the previous race hasn't worn 
off, preventing her from showing her true 
form in this race as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'd appreciate it if you could take this 
as my opinion and deliberate on it... 
Please.

True, we have been racing too much lately. 
Just as Symboli Rudolf said, we need to 
reconsider our plan.
